response.sql: WITH totals AS (SELECT team_id, SUM(ghome) AS total_home_games FROM team GROUP BY team_id), overall AS (SELECT SUM(total_home_games) AS all_home_games, AVG(total_home_games) AS average_home_games FROM totals) SELECT t.team_id, t.total_home_games, 1.0 * t.total_home_games / NULLIF(o.all_home_games, 0) AS share_of_all_home_games, 1.0 * t.total_home_games / NULLIF(o.average_home_games, 0) AS ratio_to_average FROM totals AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY ratio_to_average IS NULL, ratio_to_average DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Home games come from team.ghome. Totals and the average are calculated across team IDs over all years; SUM and AVG ignore missing values.

alternatives.interpretation: Count games recorded for each team's home parks in home_game.games instead.
alternatives.sql: WITH totals AS (SELECT ids.team_id, SUM(h.games) AS total_home_games FROM (SELECT DISTINCT team_id FROM team) AS ids LEFT JOIN home_game AS h ON h.team_id = ids.team_id GROUP BY ids.team_id), overall AS (SELECT SUM(total_home_games) AS all_home_games, AVG(total_home_games) AS average_home_games FROM totals) SELECT t.team_id, t.total_home_games, 1.0 * t.total_home_games / NULLIF(o.all_home_games, 0) AS share_of_all_home_games, 1.0 * t.total_home_games / NULLIF(o.average_home_games, 0) AS ratio_to_average FROM totals AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY ratio_to_average IS NULL, ratio_to_average DESC LIMIT 10
